newsitem.title: JAPAN: Kobe rubber futures mixed in after-hours trade.
newsitem.headline: Kobe rubber futures mixed in after-hours trade.

text.p: Kobe rubber futures were mixed in after-hours trade on Monday, after news that Japan's rubber stocks had declined as of November 10 pushed up rubber prices during the day, traders said.

Prices ranged from 0.3 yen per kg lower to 0.6 yen firmer than the day's close. Benchmark April was 0.2 yen up at 143.0 yen. Volume was thin, with 4,608 lots traded. "During the day, unexpected falls in stocks encouraged short-covering and bargain-hunting buying, but further gains could be capped by profit-taking, " one trader said.
